note: Each sign gets one pick. The pick is matched by sq (Square item id); name is for reference. Dates are month/day in Toronto time.

signs.name: Papilefiko Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Capricorn season arrives in the deepest cold, and Papilefiko brings the evergreen forest indoors. Cardamom and lavender open clean and aromatic before balsam fir, styrax and moss settle in, steady and resinous. It wears like a well-made wool coat: quiet, composed and built to last, for the climber who keeps going long after everyone else has turned back.

signs.name: Replica Jazz Club
signs.why: Aquarius is the water-bearer, pouring for everyone in the room, and Jazz Club is the room. Pink pepper and neroli lift into rum and clary sage before tobacco leaf, vanilla bean and smoky styrax take over. It suits the friend who would rather improvise than follow the chart, and it keeps you warm through the coldest stretch of February.

signs.name: La Melodie Maximal Parfum
signs.why: Pisces, the two fish, has always belonged to the water, and La Mélodie smells like a walk along the shore. Sea notes and grapefruit drift over jasmine, then ambergris, oakmoss and a soft pour of whisky give it depth. It is dreamy and easy to wear, a fitting soundtrack for the last weeks of winter as the ice starts to let go.

signs.name: Zoltan Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Aries opens the zodiac year, and Zoltan captures that first rush. Icy mint and grapefruit hit bright and bracing, then cinnamon and red rose bring the heat your ruling planet Mars is known for. Leather, tonka and amber carry it through the day with confidence. Wear it when you are ready to lead and the snow is finally giving way.

signs.name: Wulong Cha Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Taurus is ruled by Venus, the planet of pleasure, and Wulong Cha is the pleasure of a slow afternoon. Bergamot and sweet orange brighten a cup of oolong tea warmed with nutmeg, then fig and soft musk settle close to your skin. It is calm, sunny and made for May, when you finally have time to linger outside.

signs.name: Hacivat Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Gemini loves a good conversation, and Hacivat takes its name from the silver-tongued half of Turkey's famous shadow-puppet duo. Pineapple, grapefruit and bergamot open bright and quick, then cedar, patchouli and oakmoss give it a dry, grounded finish. It has two moods in one bottle, which suits you perfectly, and it moves easily from a June patio to a late dinner.

signs.name: Le Piano Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Cancer is ruled by the Moon and guided by the tides, and Le Piano smells like a summer evening by the water. Citrus and neroli open into sea notes, freesia and soft rose, then white musk and cedar settle in gently, clean and close to the skin. It feels comforting and fresh at once, made for long July days with the people you call home.

signs.name: Tempfluo Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Leo is ruled by the Sun, and Tempfluo glows like late-afternoon light in August. Saffron, mandarin and bergamot shine at the start, then orange blossom and praline add warmth before cashmere wood and vanilla carry you into the evening. It is bright, generous and a little golden, which is exactly how you like to walk into a room.

signs.name: Uomo (2021)
signs.why: Virgo season arrives with the harvest, and Valentino Uomo has the clean precision you appreciate. Bergamot and lemon open crisp and bright, powdery iris and earthy vetiver form its heart, and a finish of cardamom and black pepper keeps it sharp. Every note has a purpose, and it is right at home in September, from the office to dinner.

signs.name: Ani Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Libra is ruled by Venus, and Ani is built on the notes astrologers have long tied to that planet: rose, vanilla, benzoin and sandalwood. Sharp ginger and bergamot keep them in check, so it never tips too sweet or too fresh. It moves from a Saturday brunch to a late dinner with the easy charm your sign is known for.

signs.name: Noir Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Scorpio season runs deep, and Tom Ford Noir has the same pull. Violet and pink pepper open sharp and dark, then iris and rose lead into a base of leather, amber and vanilla with a hint of something animal. It is polished on the surface and intense underneath, which is exactly how a Scorpio prefers to be known.

signs.name: Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Your sign is the archer on horseback, forever chasing the next horizon, and Tuscan Leather smells like the journey. Saffron and raspberry flash bright at the start, then frankincense and jasmine lead into supple leather and warm amber. It is bold, generous and made for December nights when you say yes to every plan.
